text: The final scene pulls back to a galaxy. Its spiral arms contain stellar systems; the golden regions represent a hypothetical expansion of energy infrastructure. They do not show detected civilizations. Type Three in this convention means ten to the thirty sixth watts, about two point six billion solar luminosities. From Type Two, that is another factor of ten billion. There would be no instantaneous control across the galaxy: distance and the travel time of light still matter. Switch the chart from logarithmic to linear to see why the earlier levels almost disappear. This scale measures power, not well-being or intelligence.
